\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-33},
  title = {Tests and a clean clone run on a generated fixture},
  date = {2026-09-29},
  milestone = {M2: Reproducibility},
  topic = {Testing Strategy, Data Acquisition},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {\texttt{recommenditos/\allowbreak{}data/\allowbreak{}synthetic.\allowbreak{}py} generates a schema-valid stand-in for the raw snapshot from public catalogues and a seed, never by sampling the real file.
The test suite builds its fixtures from it.
\texttt{download.\allowbreak{}source} in \texttt{params.\allowbreak{}yaml} selects \texttt{synthetic} or \texttt{zenodo}, so the pipeline also runs without network and credentials.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item A sample of the real file committed to Git: puts personal data into the history of a repository the whole cohort can read.
\item No fixture: every test and every \texttt{dvc repro} would need the real file and DagsHub access.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} Nobody is blocked, and no personal data enters the Git history.
Because the source is a parameter, \texttt{dvc.\allowbreak{}lock} records which source every artefact was built from, and \texttt{dvc status} reports a workspace that disagrees.
The fixture keeps the real make skew and several listings per seller, so the seller-grouped split is testable.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI proposed the parameter and derived the fixture's edge cases from the stage tickets.
Its first implementation was wrong: the edge-case rows were copies of one row, so preprocessing would have removed most of them, and the tests only looked at the raw frame.
A second agent, asked to attack the change, found it.
A test now asserts that each case survives preprocessing.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-09-29; Lukas chose from three options.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/recommenditos/data/synthetic.py}{\texttt{synthetic.\allowbreak{}py}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/tests/test_data.py}{\texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}data.\allowbreak{}py}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/32}{issue \#32}.},
}
